description: This file defines the {@code Scope} class in the TensorFlow Java API, which manages grouping of properties and context when creating TensorFlow operations, such as name prefixes, control dependencies, and subscopes. It includes methods for creating hierarchical and controlled scopes, and for generating unique operation names.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: A final class managing TensorFlow operation creation context, including name scopes, control dependencies, and subscopes.

methods.name: Scope
methods.description: Constructor creating a top-level scope with a specified execution environment.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Returns the execution environment associated with this scope.

methods.name: withSubScope
methods.description: Creates a new sub-scope with a specified name, inheriting context from the current scope.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Creates a new scope with a specific operation name, inheriting other properties.

methods.name: makeOpName
methods.description: Generates a unique operation name within the scope, based on a default name.

methods.name: withControlDependencies
methods.description: Creates a new scope with specified control dependencies.

methods.name: applyControlDependencies
methods.description: Adds control dependencies from the scope to an OperationBuilder.
